title: Introducing “The Rewind”: The Route To Performance
summary:
Risk control and consistency and non-reliance on forecasting and high degree
of specialization and being active only in less efficient markets. But if you can do a little above average for many years and never have those
really bad years that pull the average down, I think you can have a terrific outcome with the risks under
control. I still think that you can't reliably and safely shoot for the risk under control.
